text:
tere (sec): heads-up: several nightly restore jobs started failing around 02:30 with KMS MissingGrant errors. looks like this popped right after the infra IAM rename that went out yesterday. anyone seen related alerts?

anya (encops): saw one alert. ticket auto-created: ENC-5231. initial logs show decrypt failures when puller process tries to use kms key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/f1e2d3.

sam (eng-infra): we renamed role backup-agent -> backup-uploader-v2 in the iam-modernize deploy. grant creation lambda still references the old role arn. probable cause: grants point to arn:role/backup-agent which no longer exists.

ops-bot: CloudTrail event: AssumeRole Success for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-uploader-v2 at 2026-03-08T02:29:10Z.

nate (oncall): can we hotfix by creating a grant for the new role arn? prefer ephemeral grant via tooling so we keep audit trail.

claire (platform): agree. I'll run the helper to create a grant and also add a one-off migration to update grant bindings. command: `redwood-ops kms grant add --key f1e2d3 --principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-uploader-v2 --ops Decrypt --note migrate-1771234567`

tere (sec): please attach the grant creation ARNs to the ticket and add CloudTrail entries for forensics. we need to know whether any objects were uploaded with wrong metadata or re-encrypted.

anya (encops): quick forensic query: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt` (internal script) showed successful PutObject but kms:GenerateDataKey errors for the old role. suggests the uploader retried with old creds for a bit then fell back.

marta (sec-ic): note for postmortem: role rename should be coordinated with grant-rebind job. also rotate grant TTLs to be longer than deployment window to avoid race windows during infra changes.

claire (platform): hotfix applied. created grants: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:grant/gg-1122 and gg-1123. nate, can you validate a staging restore?

nate (oncall): running `./ci/restore_canary --snap=prod-20260308 --env=staging` now.

ops-bot: Canary restore 998 queued. runner=c3 (est 4m).

nate (oncall): canary completed, decrypts OK now. leaving ticket open for durable fix.

sam (eng-infra): durable fixes: 1) update grant-creator lambda to look up role aliases from the iam registry (avoid hardcoded arns) 2) add CI check: after any role rename PR, run a dry-run that simulates grant binding (unit test) 3) increase grant TTL enforcement to min 48h for critical backup keys. I'll open PRs for #1 and #2.

tere (sec): also add an audit query to detect any KMS grants bound to principals that are not present in IAM (orphans). that should be part of the nightly security sweep.

anya (encops): adding playbook step: after CMK rotation or role rename, run `encops/tools/grant-verify --key=f1e2d3 --expected=@iam-registry` and post results to incidents. I'll add runbook section and link it in ENC-5231.

marta (sec-ic): action items summary:
- temporary grants created and canary restore validated (claire/nate)
- update grant-creator to use iam-registry (sam)
- CI dry-run for grant binding on role rename (sam)
- nightly orphan-grant detection alert (tere)
- add playbook step and runbook update (anya)

tere (sec): i'll assign owners in the ticket and schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow. thanks all. closing thread for noise but leaving ticket open for follow-up.
